title: Goiken Muyou: Anarchy in the Nippon (Demo)
native_title: 御意見無用 －Ａｎａｒｃｈｙ ｉｎ ｔｈｅ ＮＩＰＰＯＮ－
overview:
The Iron Men Rise.

Shinjuku Jackie, Ikebukuro Sara, Bunbunmaru, Kashiwa Jeffrey
Planning, production and supervision by those iron men of fighting games. What is the ideal system? What makes versus fighting fun? Here is the answer from the players who know fighting games inside out!

Along with a carefully crafted fighting system with escapes, ukemi recoveries, guard breaks and more, it is packed with new features such as an action editor that lets you edit your characters' moves yourself! Character designs by manga artist Atsushi Kase! Schoolgirls, delinquents, salarymen, housewives! Enjoy anarchic battles fought by characters who will take no back talk!

鉄人、立つ。

新宿ジャッキー　池袋サラ　ブンブン丸　柏ジェフリー
企画・制作・監修をあの格闘ゲームの鉄人たちが担当。理想のシステムとは!?　対戦格闘の面白さとは!?　格闘ゲームを知り尽くした彼らの答えがここにある！

エスケープ、受け身、ガード崩し等こだわりの格闘システムはもちろん、自らキャラクターの動きを編集できるアクションエディター機能など新要素も満載！キャラクターデザインに漫画家「加瀬あつし」を起用！コギャル、ヤンキー、サラリーマン、主婦！まさしく御意見無用なキャラクターが繰り広げるアナーキーな戦いを堪能！
